evidence: The metal sources for the thin-film depositions were trimethyl indium 98+% (99.9% In, Strem Chemicals) and diethyl zinc (min. 95%, Strem Chemicals) for In2O3 and ZnO, respectively. Water (high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) grade, Sigma-Aldrich) was used as an oxidant. Argon (99.9999%, α Gaz) was used as a carrier gas and set to a flow rate of 20 sccm during the depositions.
